aliases: Icahn School of Medicine at Mount Sinai

moodys.citation_text: Mount Sinai held A3 entering 2020 with negative outlook through pandemic. Moody's revised outlook to stable from negative June 23, 2022 and affirmed A3.

sp.citation_text: S&P historically rated Mount Sinai at A across the window. Inferred from MSHS multi-year ratings disclosures. _warning: specific S&P actions in window not directly retrieved.

fitch.citation_text: Fitch A- inferred from later Fitch downgrades implying A- was the held level entering 2020 window. _warning: not directly verified for 2020-12-31 snapshot.

rating_actions_in_window.rationale: Outlook revised to stable from negative; A3 affirmed. Recovery from COVID volume and operating headwinds, supported by federal relief and Icahn School of Medicine performance.

outcome_class_rationale: Moody's revised outlook from Negative to Stable in June 2022 — a positive credit signal. A3 rating affirmed. The big August 2023 downgrade to Baa1 is OUT-OF-WINDOW. Within 2021-2022, Mount Sinai showed COVID resilience and outlook improvement.

operating_metrics_fy2020.citation_text: Mount Sinai Health System FY2020 revenue ~$5.2B during COVID-affected year. The Mount Sinai Hospital Q1 2020 revenue alone was $799.9M implying full-year MSHS ~$5.2B. Heavy COVID burden (NYC epicenter) caused operating losses partially offset by CARES Act funding. _warning: line items inferred, not direct from audited statements.

ma_events_2021_2022.rationale: In 2021 Mount Sinai informed community that previously approved plan to relocate Beth Israel to a smaller site would not proceed; COVID forced rethink of care model. Beth Israel financial drag continued. Eventual closure not announced until 2024.
